4279-6094-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6094-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

225-783-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-783-2645-3430.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-6972-7182--212.description:
Cast the other legendary Elemental for its evoke cost by paying {4}, causing you to sacrifice it as it enters.
The Elemental's persist ability and Ashling trigger.
Resolve the Ashling trigger, creating a token copy of the Elemental.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Put the nontoken Elemental into your graveyard due to the legned rule.
When the Elemental dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat from step 5.
978-6972-7182--212.notes: If the chosen Elemental has an ETB, LTB or death ability, this combo can provide additional results from that ability. The chosen Elemental must also not enter with -1/-1 counter(s) on it.

2390-3966-7684.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-7684.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

529-1849-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3899-5035-5104.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
3899-5035-5104.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

1236-2018-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
When Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Rattleblaze Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Rattleblaze Scarecrow is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3188-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3188-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

833-1059-3478-3827.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace, Grand Warlord Radha, and at least three additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
833-1059-3478-3827.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least five mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Dimir Aqueduct, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

372-2781-5694.manaNeeded: {6}{C}{C}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-2781-5694.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Vizier of Many Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

129-1409-5434-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1479-2232-2515--164.easyPrerequisites:
One of the Deserts is in your hand with the other on the battlefield.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2232-2515--164.description:
Play a Desert.
When the Desert enters, Hazezon, Kodama, and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning another Desert from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hazezon trigger, creating two 1/1 Sand Warrior creature tokens.
When the Sand Warriors enter, Cloudstone Curio and Kodama trigger twice.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the first Kodama trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the second Kodama trigger, putting a Desert from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the Desert enters, Cloudstone Curio and Hazezon trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

254-997--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2

1445-1913-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard, and a creature card in your hand.
1445-1913-4050.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
If the returned card was an artifact creature card, Imotekh the Stormlord triggers, creating two artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.
1445-1913-4050.notes: If both cards are artifact creature cards, you'll get infinite creature tokens.

277-774-5033.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
277-774-5033.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Storm Cauldron triggers twice, returning both lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

2366-2800-3480-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2800-3480-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-2374-5413.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2374-5413.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

2963-3062-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
2963-3062-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Pir.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

147-2511-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

141-780-5231.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3240-4050-6887.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1251-3101-3292-3892.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
1251-3101-3292-3892.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1251-3101-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

4321-4772-5777-6451.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1563-2457-2557-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2103-2665-4863.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Revolutionist.
2103-2665-4863.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Revolutionist.
When the token Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

152-1283-1308-4600.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap the Chromatic Orrery tokens to draw infinite cards, or target any artifact(s) using Cogwork Assembler's ability.

3946-4011-4935.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2144-2335.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat step 1 until Barrenton Medic dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Myrkul triggers, causing you to exile Barrenton Medic and create a token copy of Barrenton Medic that is an enchantment and loses all other card types.
Whenever damage would be dealt to you or a permanent you control, activate the Barrenton Medic token's first ability by tapping it, preventing one damage to you or that permanent.
Activate the Barrenton Medic token's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4 as necessary.

1563-1651-1737-3342-4321.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Thieves' Tools and a Food artifact token.
When the Thieves' Tools token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure and a Food artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Foods, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate the Thieves' Tools token and the Treasure token by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

190-953-1371-5042.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, targeting Teferi's Ageless Insight.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Fractured Identity.
Resolve each opponent's Fractured Identity.
Resolve your Fractured Identity, exiling Teferi's Ageless Insight and causing each opponent to create a copy of it.
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Enter the Infinite.
Resolve the first opponent's Enter the Infinite, causing the opponent to draw cards equal to twice their deck size, and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
Repeat step 7 for each other opponent.

914-2034-5128.notablePrerequisites:
Dockside Extortionist has a sticker on it.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2034-5128.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

215-2557-4231-4634.description:
Cast Wavesifter for its evoke cost by paying {G}{U}.
Wavesifter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and its evoke ability.
Resolve the first Wavesifter trigger, creating four Clue, four Treasure, and four Food tokens.
Activate the four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wavesifter from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Wavesifter trigger from step 2, failing to sacrifice Wavesifter due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat.

578-617-4235.notablePrerequisites:
2 or more artifacts in hand.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
578-617-4235.description:
Activate Metalworker and reveal 2 artifacts to add {C}{C}{C}{C} to your mana pool.
Activate Voltaic Key to untap Metalworker.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers allowing you to copy Voltaic Key's ability and untap Voltaic key with the copy.
Repeat.
